about: Hand-checked corrections applied by `pipeline build` (see pipeline/corrections.py). The 2026-09-23 entries were found by re-reading the live menu during that day's price check; all but Tavern on Jane and Jimbo's Hamburger Palace were confirmed by two independent checks. Every 2026-09-24 entry was confirmed by two independent checks; where the restaurant's own current menu page can be scraped, the fix is a menu-URL override in pipeline/data/menu_urls.json instead (re-scraped on the next run). The 2026-09-25 entries come from the review of each restaurant's one published burger (its highest-priced beef burger): Boeuf & Bun and the two Carnegie Diners were re-read on their own current menu pages; the Grillify-NYC delivery prices could not be confirmed; and the Grubhub/Seamless entries withhold pages whose cached scrape shows only the Best Sellers / recently ordered items (the burger section never loaded). Remove one of those once a full menu for the restaurant has been scraped.

corrections.reason: the $32 Boucherie Burger is the lunch price; dinner, late lunch and brunch list it at $34. The $18 beef sliders are a bar-only Green Hour (happy hour) item.
'Create Your Own Burger' is a section heading; its $5.95 is the lettuce, tomato and fries add-on, not a burger.
the $14.95 beef sliders are a shared plate of three sliders, not a burger; the Houston Hall Burger & Fries ($21.95) is the only full-size burger.
the $20 prices came from an out-of-date aggregator copy; the restaurant's own menu lists its burgers at $23.71 (beef sliders are $3.09 each, minimum two, bar menu only).
the $26 came from an aggregator copy last updated in 2022; the restaurant's dinner and brunch menus list the Bacon Cheeseburger at $30.
$24 is the lunch price; the JG Burger is $28 on the dinner menu (Monday addition) and at brunch, and the index uses dinner prices.
the scrape missed the Smash Burgers section; Paul's Smash Burger ($9.25) is cheaper than the $9.50 Beef Burger.

add.name: Paul's Smash Burger
add.description: 2.5 oz patty with cheese, lettuce, tomato, raw onion, pickles and Russian dressing

corrections.reason: the page scraped showed only four featured burgers; the full ordering menu starts at the $24 Original Tavern Burger. Its dine-in menu may list lower prices.
the $16 came from a retired online-ordering page; the restaurant's lunch menu lists the Bacon Cheeseburger & Fries at $24 (dinner has no burger).
drop: 6 Oz. La Freida Bacon Cheese Burger

corrections.reason: the $13 Waverly Burger came from an aggregator copy that looks years out of date (recent menus list it well above $30), and the restaurant publishes no menu to check against.
the $15.95 Cheeseburger Sliders are an appetizer (a mini version of the sirloin burger), a shared slider plate; the cheapest standalone beef burger is the BEST BURGER on 26th Street at $16.50.
the $16 Mini Rodeo Burgers are listed under 'Shares & Sides' (a shared plate of mini burgers); the cheapest standalone beef burger is the Double Smash Burger at $19.

Astoria Park South ($12.99: smashed burger, two eggs, cheddar, grilled Texas toast) is a breakfast sandwich from the breakfast section, not a menu burger; the Burgers section starts at the BYO Burger ($16.99).
'Cheeseburger Sliders (2)' ($10.35) is a two-slider plate among the snacks and starters; the only full-size burger is the Double Patty Cheeseburger at $15.55.
the $3.25 Beef and Chicken Sliders are single mini patties, not standard-size burgers (Grubhub sells the beef ones only as a pair); the cheapest standard beef burger is the Classic Burger at $8.50.

the $14 Cheeseburger Sliders (3) are listed 'For the Table' (a shared plate); on the official FiDi menu the cheapest standalone beef burgers are the Fondue and German Burgers at $18, the same prices as the SinglePlatform copy.

'2 Mini Slammers' ($12.95) are two slider-size versions of the house burger on dinner rolls, not a single standard-size burger; the cheapest standard beef burger is the Bistro Burger (1/2 lb, with fries) at $16.95.
the $17.50 Scotch Bonnet Sliders are a plate of sliders in the 'Classics' section; the cheapest standalone beef burger is the Bacon Cheddar Burger at $23.50.

Classic Sliders ($19.50, 3 pieces with fries) are a slider plate, and the $18 Golden B.E.C. Burger is on the 11am-2pm brunch menu only; the cheapest all-day standard beef burger is the Classic American at $20.50.
the $24 Cheeseburger Sliders are a 'Shareables' bar snack; the greywind burger is $34 on the dinner and all-day menus.
the $15 slider plates (three sliders each) are appetizers; the HT Burger (8oz Angus, with fries) is $16.
the $19 Beef Sliders (3 pieces) are a 'Sharable Starters' plate; the Hurley's Burger is $22.
the $12 Cheeseburger Sliders (3) are an appetizer plate; the cheapest standalone beef burger is the Hamburger at $13.
Classic Sliders ($18 for 3, $24 for 5, with fries) are a slider plate; the cheapest standalone beef burger is the 8oz Maclaren Sirloin Burger at $20.
the $16 Mini Blue Sliders and Beef Sliders are plates of mini burgers in a separate Sliders section; the cheapest standalone beef burger is Mulligan's Burger at $18.
Mustang Sliders (4 for $21, 8 for $34) are a shared starter; the cheapest standalone beef burger is The Mustang Burger (with fries) at $23.
the $24 Wagyu Beef Sliders are a Small Plates item (a shared plate); O'Toole's Burger is $26 on the all-day menu.
Sliders with Cheese ($12.50, 3 pieces) are an appetizer, also sold as a catering tray; the cheapest standalone beef burger is the Hamburger at $15.50.
'The Frank' ($9.99) is a 1/4 lb beef frank in a hot dog bun, not a burger, and the '3 ... Sliders' items are slider plates; the cheapest beef burger is the Temptation at $15.99.

the $15 Beef Sliders (4 pieces) are a 'To Share' plate and the $3 sliders a daily special; the regular burgers are the Rasher and Slainte Burgers at $18 (the $15 Sunday Burger is a once-a-week special).
Stout Mini Burgers ($18, 'extra mini burger $4', also sold as a party tray) are a shared appetizer; the cheapest standalone beef burger is the Double Stacked Smashed Burger at $20.
the $13 Baby Burgers (3) are sliders among the snack plates (also part of the shared platter); the cheapest full-size beef burger is the Classic Cheeseburger (with fries) at $19.
the $16 Mini Burgers are a 'Shares & Sides' plate; the only standalone beef burger is the Signature Burger at $21.
the $17 Mini Burgers (3) are a 'To Share' plate; the cheapest standalone beef burger is The Quality Burger at $18.
the $18 Cheeseburger Sliders are a 'Shares' plate; the index burger is The Standard Burger, also $18.
the $9.50 Burger Sliders are half-size sliders for groups (pre-order, 10 minimum); the Smash and Dry-Aged Burgers are $18.90.
Black Angus Beef Sliders (3 for $18, 10 for $55) are a Small Plates item; the cheapest standalone beef burger is the Treadwell Junior Burger (4 oz, with fries), also $18.
Smash Sliders (3) ($17) are a starter plate; the Burgers section starts at the Classic ($18, with fries or salad).

the scraped $6.39, $9.36 and $8.37 are an auto-applied 10%-off promotion; the menu prices at the Downtown Brooklyn shop (113 Court St) are $7.10, $10.40 and $9.30. Other locations differ (the Smashburger is $6.50 in Bushwick, $8.10 on Staten Island).
the brunch menu was scraped (Boogie Down Burger $22); the dinner menu lists the Beatstro UFO Burger at $25 and the index uses dinner prices (its $16 Murda Burgers are two sliders among the starters).

corrections.reason: $17.95 is the lunch price (11:30am-3pm) of the build-your-own USDA Prime Signature Blend burger; the dinner menu lists it at $19.95, bun included.
the scrape missed part of the 'Build a Burger' section: the Single Smash Beef Burger (4 oz, $14) is cheaper than the 8 oz Beef Burger ($15); the $13 burgers are weekday 1-4pm lunch specials.

$28 is the Wednesday-only lunch price (the dinner menu has no burger); the bar menu, served in the bar area, lists The Glass House Burger at $23 (its $20 filet mignon sliders are a shared appetizer). The Salmon Burger is on the lunch menu only.
the ordering page scraped missed the plain Beef Burger; Grubhub's '1/2 lb. Angus Burgers' for 1715 2nd Ave list it at $14.50, and its other burger prices match the scraped page to the cent.
the Uber Eats page scraped missed the Beef Burger; the same Uber catalog on Postmates lists it at $18.95, below the $19.95 Cheese Burger (the $12 Monday burger is a promotion).
the scrape caught two of the diner's charbroiled burgers; the full Seamless/Grubhub menu for 402 W 34th St starts at the plain 9 oz. Burger ($11.50).

the official page scraped showed only the $21 beef and hot chicken sliders (appetizer plates): its sandwich section never loaded, and the site blocks automated reads. Grubhub/Seamless for 247 W 30th St lists the standalone Burger at $20.40, a delivery price (its sliders are $24 there, $21 in-store).

corrections.reason: Adobe Blues appears to have closed (Yelp lists it as closed; adobeblues.com shows only a hosting error page), so the $11 House Cheeseburger on this old SinglePlatform copy is not a current price.
the NYC restaurant (152 Stanton St) closed in 2026 and this SinglePlatform page is an old copy (its wine list has 2010-2014 vintages); balvanerarestaurants.com lists only Pittsburgh now.

BarBacon (836 9th Ave) has closed (Yelp lists it as closed; Bocca di Bacco is at the address), so this MenuPages copy is not a current menu. On it the $14 BarBacon Sliders are a shared bar bite; the BarBacon Burger was $15.
Blue Hour, the counter inside the BP station at 1525 Myrtle Ave, closed on September 30, 2025 (BK Mag); the $7 smashburger is from its 2024 opening coverage.
the page scraped is Burger Plus in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, a different restaurant; the Queens place (kosher, 147-41 Union Tpke) is listed as closed, so there is no menu to price.

the page scraped is the Farmingdale, Long Island menu of Croxley's (whose locations are all on Long Island); the East Village Croxley Ales at 28 Avenue B closed on August 30, 2017 (Gothamist, EV Grieve).
the Icehouse Café lost its Hammond's Cove Marina concession and closed on April 1, 2023 (Bronx Times, PIX11); this SinglePlatform page ($12.95 Hamburger) is a leftover copy.
the menu page is a 2013 copy and Idle Hands Bar (25 Ave B) is listed as closed (reported closed during the pandemic), so its prices are not current.
Korzo (667 5th Ave) closed in December 2022 (Patch) and its own domain now redirects to an unrelated site; this SinglePlatform page is a leftover copy.
Mekelburg's closed for good on January 1, 2026 (Greenpointers, Brooklyn Magazine) and mekelburgs.com is parked; the $22 Brunch Burger comes from a leftover ordering page.
the page scraped is O'Brien's Pub in Hillsboro, Oregon (2020 NE Cornell Road), a different restaurant; no online menu was found for the Kingsbridge pub.
this SinglePlatform copy has years-old prices ($7.25 Classic Burger, $11.95 one-pound burgers) and Riverdale Diner (3657 Kingsbridge Ave) is listed as closed.

Sardi's is closed for a refresh under new owners (the Shubert Organization, with La Masseria Group operating) and due to reopen in fall 2026; this SinglePlatform menu is the previous operator's, and no new menu has been published.

the dinner page scraped is years out of date (Kobe Beef Sliders $18), and the two re-checks found different current prices for that sliders dish ($21 on the restaurant's homepage menu, $26 on Grubhub), so no price is shown until the menu is re-read.

The Cecil Steakhouse is listed as permanently closed (The Infatuation, Yelp) and its domain now serves an unrelated site; this SinglePlatform copy ($17 Cecil Burger) is out of date (its closed Grubhub listing shows a different, higher-priced burger menu).
Jean-Georges' Mercer Kitchen (99 Prince St) closed at the end of 2022 and another restaurant opened in the space in 2023; this SinglePlatform page ($27 Mercer Burger) is a leftover copy.

the Uber Eats prices scraped are the restaurant's own prices grossed up by about 79% (every one is the in-store price divided by 0.56). Boeuf & Bun's own ordering page lists the Double Trouble Burger (two patties, 1 lb total) at $32, not $57.14, and the other burgers at $13 to $28.

the Postmates and Uber Eats prices are marked up for delivery (each one is a .99 menu price divided by 0.775: $33.53 for a $25.99 burger), and the restaurant's own sites have lapsed, so no in-store price could be confirmed.
